release_notes.headline_internal: Claims-vs-facts defect class: findings route to backlog, avoidance respects require review authority, progress-vs-retry discrimination, visible budget clamp
release_notes.headline_external: Finding routing, respects-evidence enforcement, and honest retry accounting
highlights: Mid-lifecycle findings route to adv_backlog_add via command contract claims with drift-guard asset tests
Respects claims on avoidance/out_of_scope items require task-scoped adv-reviewer authority at acceptance and release gates
Retry reducer distinguishes productive review rounds (disjoint findings) from failed retries (overlapping findings)
Budget clamp emits visible budget_warning marker instead of silently dropping history; submission never refuses at/over budget
adv_change_create surfaces bounded portfolio state with graceful degradation

breaking.description: The new checkRespectsEvidenceAuthority gate check blocks acceptance/release for done tasks whose contract_refs.respects target avoidance (DONT) or out_of_scope (OOS) items without task-scoped adv-reviewer report authority. Existing changes at acceptance without per-task reviewer reports for such tasks will be blocked until /adv-review produces them.
breaking.migration: Run /adv-review on any in-flight change whose done tasks respect DONT/OOS items. The review produces task-scoped adv-reviewer reports that satisfy the check.
